subject: Request: one-time service compensation & amendment for production latency impact
messages:
From: Alex Hopper <alex.hopper@novaworks.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: NovaWorks Billing <billing@novaworks.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production latency incident 2026-08-24 — compensation request

Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this call earlier. As a quick follow-up: NovaWorks experienced repeated latency spikes across our core inference endpoints between 02:30 and 06:15 PDT on 2026-08-24. Our monitoring shows 18 partial request failures and sustained p95 latency spikes to ~3.2s (normal ~450ms) that impacted live checkout for several customers. We've attached a short timeline and the logs we captured.

This incident resulted in lost transactions we’re estimating at ~$42k for that morning window. Per the SLA language in our contract (section 4.2), we expect a service credit conversation — please advise what remediation/redress Redwood is prepared to offer.

We need a firm proposal by end-of-week; our finance & procurement teams want this captured as an amendment or one-off credit to close the month.

Alex Hopper
VP Product
NovaWorks

Attachments: incident-timeline.csv (attachment stub), request-logs-trimmed.txt (attachment stub)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Hopper <alex.hopper@novaworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency incident 2026-08-24 — compensation request

Alex — thanks for the clear timeline and for sharing the logs. I’m really sorry NovaWorks hit that window; I know how disruptive these spikes are for checkout flows.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- Ops is already running a narrowed postmortem (ETA: draft by Wed EOD).
- I’ll propose a one-time remediation package to cover demonstrated impact and help stabilize your traffic during the upcoming marketing push.

Preliminary ask to you: can you confirm the $42k estimate from finance so we can map to a credit? Also confirm whether you’d prefer a straight billing credit or a combination (billing credit + two months of discounted Dedicated capacity for sustained throughput while we tune). Either is fine — we want to close this this week.

I’ve looped in Karthik for exec sign-off on any exception/one-off credit; Marissa will coordinate legal/Docs to put an amendment in place.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Production latency incident 2026-08-24 — proposed concession (internal)

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding the customer ask and Ops' preliminary findings (attached). Below is my recommended remediation package so we can move to DocuSign if you approve: 

Recommended one-time remediation package (proposal):
- Straight billing credit equal to 100% of verified lost transactions up to $50,000 (to match the customer estimate).
- Plus two months of Dedicated capacity at 50% off the list price, applied as a service credit (to help NovaWorks through the next two marketing campaigns while we finalize performance fixes).
- Cap: package value to be capped at $75,000 aggregate to limit exposure.
- Implementation: Finance to reflect a credit on the next invoice; Legal to issue a brief amendment (term: one-off, no SLA baseline change).

Why this structure: it balances compensating demonstrable revenue loss with a forward-looking remediation that reduces the chance of repeated impact (we're offering both immediate monetary redress and operational assistance).

Action requested: please confirm approval or countersign by Friday (2026-08-28 COB). If approved, Marissa — can you pull a short amendment template and route to Alex for signature? I’ve attached the ops postmortem draft and incident timeline.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ops-postmortem-draft.pdf (attachment stub), incident-timeline.csv (attachment stub), service-amendment-template.docx (attachment stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production latency incident 2026-08-24 — proposed concession (internal)

Vanessa / Marissa — I reviewed the ops notes and your proposed package. Approve the remediation package with one adjustment:

- Approve the structure (billing credit + two months discounted Dedicated capacity) but set the aggregate cap to $75,000 (your proposal already included this cap; confirm we enforce it).
- Require Legal to issue a short amendment stating this is a one-time concession and does not alter the SLA baseline.

Marissa — please prepare the amendment and route through DocuSign; cc me when you send to NovaWorks. Vanessa — once DocuSign complete, confirm how we will post the credit on their account (billing code / invoice note).

Karthik Iyer
VP, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
